title: 记忆适应 · 简洁对照标杆

source.prompt: Create one small publication-ready 2D robot mascot illustration, an original research-assistant robot for an academic computer-science diagram. Transparent alpha background, no white plate, no checkerboard, no shadow outside the character. Front-facing compact friendly robot bust with a rounded rectangular light cyan screen face, dark charcoal clean outline of consistent moderately thick weight, two small side ears, a short antenna, two simple eyes and a subtle smile, small turquoise neck/base. Three-quarter details are unnecessary, keep a flat frontal silhouette. Soft desaturated cyan and pale blue fills, minimal flat shading, crisp readable at 48 pixels tall, restrained cute style suitable for a scientific paper rather than a toy advertisement. No letters, numbers, badges, text, symbols, watermarks, arrows, glow, 3D rendering or decorative background. Character centered and complete with only a small transparent margin. Produce a single isolated robot, not a sheet and not multiple variants.

evidence.title: AI 生成的论文助手机器人
evidence.reference: 由平台 imagegen 工具生成；原图保留于 resources/paper/robot-source.png，生成说明与原图指纹见 robot-origin.json。
